config.awesome_spears.title: Awesome Spears · Config
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.lunge: Controls whether this mod changes the Lunge enchantment.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.lunge_no_h: Lunging costs no hunger, and works even when you are hungry.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.lunge_in_a: Lets you lunge while flying with an elytra.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.lunge_foll: Lunges toward your crosshair, up and down included. When off, lunges are horizontal only.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.lunge_whil: Lunge by left-clicking while charging with right-click; this lunges without stabbing. When off, every stab lunges.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.lunge_afte: Right-clicking to charge right after a stab also lunges and skips the charge wind-up. Needs "Lunge While Charging".
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.charge: Controls whether this mod changes the spear charge attack.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.charge_kno: Charge hits knock the target back.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.charge_kee: Charge hits no longer slow you down or stop your sprint.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.hit: Controls whether this mod changes spear hit detection.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.hit_point_: Lets you hit targets right in front of your face.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.hit_wider_: Makes the spear's hitbox wider, so hits land more easily.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.hit_moving: Checks again along the target's movement, so you don't need to lead moving targets.
config.awesome_spears.tooltip.hit_point_: Halves damage against targets closer than 2 blocks.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.awesome_spear: A gameplay mod that makes spears and the Lunge enchantment actually worth using.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.awesome_s: The Lunge enchantment is an absolute glutton - how does it manage to consume even more than I do? The Lunge spear seems like a perfect tool for taking flight with an elytra, but why it’s unusable while airborne? And why can’t I combine the built-in speed boost from the enchantment with the spear’s own right-click charge attack? Where did the knockback go? Why can’t I land a hit on a mob that’s clearly within my attack range? Hey, I’m aiming toward the sky, but why do I still end up dashing sideways? And why can’t I seem to move forward when I’m in the water? Trust me: once you install this mod, all these frustrations will vanish into thin air. Hopefully.
